title: A new GPT-4.1-mini model option
summary:
A new GPT-4.1-mini model option arrived alongside more reliable JSON Schema forwarding and a tidier model list.

Added `openai-roblox` with text and image input, text output, and tool support. The same PR also changed Roblox-referrer routing to use llamascout, preserved the first existing system message in model context wrappers, corrected Phi-4 Instruct’s provider listing, and adjusted the hypnosisTracy persona’s spacing instructions.

The OpenAI-compatible text endpoint now forwards the full `response_format` object to compatible models instead of dropping a supplied JSON schema. JSON mode still falls back to `{ "type": "json_object" }` when no response format is supplied.

Removed `llama-vision` from the text API’s available-models list, so it is no longer advertised as an option.
